records.name: Flyout
records.tagline: Rich-text notes that fly out from your Mac's screen edge
records.description: Nudge your screen edge — or press ⌥⌘N — and a full rich-text editor flies out over whatever you're doing. Checklists, reminders, folders, images, code blocks, iCloud sync. Native macOS, not Electron. Lifetime license, 7-day free trial. Every note is plain Markdown underneath. Your notes never touch our servers.

records.name: Portero
records.tagline: Know exactly what's running on every port of your Mac
records.description: Portero is a free, open source Mac app that shows every open port and the process behind it. See what's running, kill processes on busy ports, fix 'address already in use' errors, and block ports with the built-in macOS firewall.

records.name: Mojave Paint
records.tagline: Direct manipulation of static images on the Mac platform
records.description: Bitmap images are still, even in 2026, a hugely important medium of communication. Which is why I made Mojave Paint – a Mac-based image editor that lets you really own the production of these bitmap images. They've been making image editors since the original Mac and the Amiga and I'm sure even long before that. But somehow the choices in the modern era fall short. So I have a new option, presented by an upstart software shop in Seattle. If you're looking for AI features, look elsewhere.

records.name: Sales Studio
records.tagline: Private studio for live demos on macOS
records.description: Sales Studio is a private studio for live demos on macOS. Your audience sees one clean, polished screen share in Zoom, Meet, or Teams. You see your script, notes, talking points, and every display you might switch to. No more window juggling.

records.name: PgDog
records.tagline: Scale PostgreSQL without changing your app
records.description: PgDog is an open source connection pooler, load balancer, and sharding proxy for PostgreSQL. It's Postgres-compliant, fast, secure and built in the open by a community of database engineers.

records.name: loopclub
records.tagline: The shared drum machine to jam with strangers or with Claude
records.description: loopclub is a realtime, onchain drum machine — beat-making turned into a multiplayer, ownable act. Sporting a 16-step, 9-track sequencer running entirely onchain. The grid updates live as other people claim cells around you, so a loop is built collaboratively, in real time. Record a loop you like and every cell owner earns on each copy pressed. Or ask Claude to write you one. Listening and auditioning are free. Fully open source at https://github.com/mintcloud/loopclub

records.name: VocalVia

records.description: VocalVia turns PDFs, Word files, Markdown, web articles, and pasted text into structured outlines, editable podcast scripts, and natural multi-voice audio. Choose speakers and voices, refine individual segments, then export the finished audio. It is built for saved reading, study notes, research papers, and long-form content you want to listen to away from a screen.

records.name: Claude Overlay

records.name: Sourclip

records.description: Sourclip is the research workflow for NotebookLM. records.name: Goose Ads Remixer
records.tagline: Remix the ads already winning in your niche
records.description: The winning ads in your niche reveal what works: hooks, offers, copy structures, layouts. Goose learns those patterns and creates new ads for your brand with your real logo, product images, and messaging in minutes. First 10 ads free.

records.name: FINAI by Synlabs
records.tagline: Ultra-low latency predictive ML layer
records.description: FINAI 2.0 — an ultra-low-latency predictive ML layer for markets. Feature engineering → training → strict no-look-ahead sim → inference, in Rust/C++ at 4–50 µs/tick, enabling tick-level backtesting. Per-bar signals (probabilities + raw) across tickers & timeframes, asset-agnostic, strictly causal. Transparent by design: live public board + immutable S3 audit trail — every signal timestamped, independently verifiable. For market makers, execution desks & systematic funds.

records.name: World Color
records.tagline: Your mood, not your posts — mapped in real time
records.description: Color is a social network for how you feel, not what you did. Pick a color from an emotion-mapped wheel. Add a note if you want, or let the color speak. Your post goes onto a live world map — no algorithm, no feed ranking, just moods blooming in real time across the globe. No followers to chase. No likes to count. No text required. Just a dot on the map that says: this is what I felt, here, now.

records.name: FormFeed
records.tagline: Add working forms to any static site in minutes
records.description: Give any static site a real form backend: paste in one endpoint and submissions arrive in your inbox in seconds. Built-in spam filtering, a clean dashboard, and CSV export. 14-day free trial, no credit card. Made for people who ship.

records.name: WooCommerce MCP
records.tagline: Let Claude read your WooCommerce store - safely, read-only
records.description: A small open-source MCP server that gives Claude (or any MCP client) live answers about your WordPress + WooCommerce store: products, stock, recent orders, sales reports, blog posts. Read-only by design - no writes, no plugin installs, just the official REST APIs with read keys. MIT, TypeScript. Built by wppoland.com.

records.name: RANKMAKER
records.tagline: Build accurate rankings through 1v1 battles
records.description: RANKMAKER lets you build precise, personal rankings through fast 1v1 matchups instead of dragging items into arbitrary tiers. Pick a template, movies, music, sports, anime, food and more, or create your own with 4 to 50 options, and let the battles decide what really comes out on top. Sign in with GitHub to save your profile and templates, see a live podium and full ranked list when you finish, and share your results as an image or on X. Fully open source.

records.name: Literie
records.tagline: Read captivating stories anytime, anywhere.
records.description: Literie is a digital reading platform packed with thousands of novels across romance, fantasy, mystery, werewolf, billionaire, teen fiction, and more. Discover exclusive stories from emerging authors, receive regular content updates, personalize your reading experience, and enjoy a growing library designed for book lovers who never run out of stories.

records.name: AI Act Checker
records.tagline: Check if your chatbot breaks the EU AI Act — free scan
records.description: A free tool that scans any URL for chatbot providers and flags whether an AI-disclosure notice is present. Built ahead of Article 50 of the EU AI Act — the rule requiring AI systems to disclose they're AI, enforceable from August 2, 2026, regardless of where your company is based. Paste a URL, get an instant result. Not a legal audit — a fast way to know if you need to look closer.

records.name: SpecRabbit
records.tagline: Draw your architecture. Zero guesswork for AI.
records.description: SpecRabbit replaces text-based architecture specs with a visual typed node graph. Unlike prose descriptions, it enforces completeness - you can't add an endpoint without auth level or a database connection without query to run. The export is raw JSON/YAML graph topology with built-in AI instructions, not a screenshot or markdown. Every node combines structured parameters with free text for behavioral context. The result: AI coding agents generate code matching your design, not their assumptions.

records.name: Identity Labs by PandaCraft Sites
records.tagline: 9 advanced name generators, trivia arenas & leaderboards.
records.description: Identity Labs is a next-generation naming studio built under the PandaCraft Sites banner. Stop using random text generators that give you messy results. We deliver 9 symmetrically balanced naming engines, 13 interactive quiz arenas, and live competitive leaderboards. Whether you need a premium fashion trademark, a fast cloud kitchen identity, or a try hard gaming clan tag, we calculate your perfect digital footprint with zero friction.

records.name: SearchOptimo
records.tagline: SearchOptimo – Bulk Index Checker & Deindexing Monito
records.description: Bulk-check Google indexing for thousands of URLs at once and monitor 24/7 for deindexing. No Search Console login required.

records.name: Pazi
records.tagline: Vibe code business operations
records.description: Pazi is an AI team for that idea you keep coming back to — a book, a shop, an app, a skill you want to sell. Tell Pazi what you're trying to do and it builds a team of agents around your idea and starts making things happen: a website, first outreach, content, the next step. Every time you come back, something has moved. You stay in control; your team does the rest alongside you, one real step at a time. Like vibe coding but for business operations.

records.name: Online Tool Yard
records.tagline: Collection of fast, secure, and client-side utility tools
records.description: OnlineToolYard is a collection of fast, secure, and fully client-side utility tools for developers and designers. It offers tools for encoding/decoding, text formatting, JSON & data conversion, hashing, color design, and network lookups—running entirely in the browser with no data sent to any server.

records.name: Beryl
records.tagline: Make Repositories Ready For Agents
records.description: I built Beryl to fix my own problem. My coding agents were good, but my repo had rules scattered across AGENTS.md, prompt.md, and a myriad more markdown files that quietly drifted apart. I couldn't trust that a code edit that followed them. Beryl is open source. It doesn't replace your agent. It gives the *repository* one place to own its rules and one command to check them.

records.name: VerifiedTools
records.tagline: Free tools that work. No accounts, no trials.
records.description: We’re tired of "free" tools that secretly require a credit card or force you to create an account just to test them out. VerifiedTools is a curated, open-source directory of genuinely free utilities. The best part? Our automated bot pings every single tool daily to verify it's still alive and hasn't added a forced login wall. If it asks for a signup, it's not here. Find exactly what you need instantly no strings attached.

records.name: Consortium
records.tagline: LLM apps Smarter & Cheaper, Reliable, Auditable in 1 min
records.description: Cosortium acts as a proxy for LLM calls. With 1 LOC change (API URL), make any LLM powered app - Smarter & Cheaper: via Ensemble topologies, like OpenRouter's Fusion. On some tasks you can get Fable performance for 1-6% the cost by fusing responses of mutli cheaper llms - Reliable: Durable DAG execution improves success rates of LLMs by an order of magnitude. Via result parsing, automatic retries - Optimizable: Built-in wiring for benchmarks, with autoresearch/GEPA/MIPROv2-style optimization

records.name: Garden Guard
records.tagline: Cozy garden tower defense — bugs vs. your veggies
records.description: Garden Guard is a cozy tower defense. Bugs march down a winding path toward your veggies — plant the right pest-control gear (pellet guns, bug spray, zappers, flamethrowers, Venus traps and more) to stop every last one. Ten upgradeable tools, freshly generated maps, bosses, and a one-tap Nuclear Option for when you're overrun. Beat 30 maps to unlock Endless mode. Free for the first 8 maps; a one-time $0.99 unlocks everything. No tracking. iPhone + iPad.

records.name: Komisyonsuz
records.tagline: Commission-free online ordering system
records.description: Komisyonsuz, helps restaurants, cafes, and local businesses create their own commission-free online ordering channels. Unlike marketplace platforms, businesses keep control of their brand, customers, and sales. With QR menu ordering, online payments, white-label solutions, and multi-location management, Komisyonsuz transforms QR menus into a complete self-service ordering experience where customers can order, send orders directly to the kitchen, and pay from the same QR menu page.

records.name: AURA Growth System

Instead of you entering data, AI operates your business — from sales to accounting to inventory. Built for SMBs in Mexico & LatAm.

Create ready-to-use lists in seconds, distribute them to your sales team and export or send them to your CRM. Built with LGPD-conscious workflows and invite-only access.

records.name: PrOpinion — Ask a Pro.Trust the Opinion.

Just a straight answer from AI that knows its stuff. Available for Motor, Home, Money, Work, Travel, Tech & Scams, and Education. Ask a Pro. Trust the Opinion.

Now with native ARM support, improved performance, and a completely free, offline experience—no ads, subscriptions, or feature restrictions.

records.name: CostMyDish

The account features a pilot program contribution of $1,000 for children born between Jan. 1, 2025, and Dec. 31, 2028, and who are U.S. citizens with a valid Social Security number.

records.name: SubTrack — Subscription Tracker

Know exactly where your money goes. ⏰ Renewal Reminders — Get notified before a subscription renews so you can decide: keep it or cancel it.

records.name: SkinFam

records.name: ScanFlyGo

records.description: ContextGrade captures the reasoning behind your team's decisions inside Jira, Figma, Salesforce, HubSpot or any other web app and turns it into structured context you can hand to ChatGPT, Claude, or your own agents. Not just a human audit trail. Your team makes decisions every day. The reasoning disappears every time. ContextGrade captures the why behind important decisions across any tool and turns it into structured context your LLM can actually use.

records.name: CliPad
records.tagline: ClipPad is AI organizational memory for company knowledge!!

Teams create valuable knowledge, but it often gets lost. ClipPad helps teams capture, organize, and search knowledge with AI, keeping everyone aligned and working smarter. We'd love your feedback and support!

records.name: Heracue
records.tagline: Cycle intelligence that tracks what your body actually does
records.description: Heracue is a women's health intelligence app that tracks what your body actually does not what an algorithm assumes. Most apps guess your ovulation. Heracue confirms it. Real ovulation, true DPO, fertile window, moods, and sleep all connected in one place. Built for women who are TTC, off birth control, or done guessing. Your body isn't random. It speaks every day. Heracue helps you understand.

records.name: Liquid State

records.description: A free Bloomberg-style crypto terminal. Drag-and-resize widget grid: live order flow, liquidations, $1M+ whale transfers, stablecoin mint/burn, macro calendar, 50+ indicators, daily Briefs, and an AI analyst grounded in live computed data. No login needed.

records.name: AutoShelf 2.0
records.tagline: Auto-organize files on your Mac now with MCP & CLI support
records.description: AutoShelf is a macOS app that watches your folders and auto-organizes files. Set a rule once and never think about it again. Free to try, unlock unlimited for $19.99.

records.name: ScrollStop
records.tagline: Block distracting apps when it is time to focus
records.description: ScrollStop is a simple Android focus blocker for anyone who keeps losing time to distracting apps. Create a Focus Plan, choose the apps you want blocked, start a session, and ScrollStop keeps those apps closed until your focus time ends. No account. No ads. No cloud sync. No subscription. Just a local-first focus utility for study, work, sleep, deep work, and everyday routines.

records.name: Altersend
records.tagline: File transfer with no cloud storage, no account, no limits
records.description: AlterSend sends files directly between devices - P2P, E2EE, no cloud storage, no account, no size limits. Open source and cross-platform: mobile + desktop. Share a code or scan a QR, and files stream straight across.

It helps you create shopping lists, set weekly or monthly budgets, track your spending as you shop, and review monthly spending reports so you can make smarter decisions and save money over time.

records.name: ReMail by Quarred

records.description: ShopInBook organizes weekly ads from tens of nearby stores (Food 4 Less, Walmart, Target, Ralphs, or Costco, etc.). You can search for specific things to see if that's on sale on any of the stores. e.g. I usually shop at Food 4 less and had been waiting on chicken wings meats to go on sale for $.99 per pound (usually $1.39). Unfortunately, it hasn't been on sale for a while. But when I used Shopinbook, it showed right away that a grocery store 15 minutes away had it on sale for $.99 per pound.

records.name: ToolBoxesAi OnScreen Qr
records.tagline: Scan Any Qr Or Barcodes Directly From Your Screen
records.description: From start to result in under a second — no camera, no second device, no hassle. Just tap the floating bubble to instantly scan any QR code or barcode straight from your screen. Detects codes with up to 97% accuracy and scans in under 500ms, 100% offline and battery-efficient. Instantly categorizes links, WiFi, UPI payments, emails, and contacts. Built-in threat detection flags phishing and scam risks before you tap. Batch Scan up to 200 codes at once; export history to Excel.

records.name: Longest Domain Name vs Short Domain
records.tagline: Choose the Right Domain for Business Growth
records.description: Compare the benefits of long and short domain names to find the best choice for your business. Learn how domain length affects branding, SEO, user trust, memorability, and online visibility. Discover why shorter domains are often easier to type, share, and remember, while longer domains can provide added context and keywords. Make an informed decision that supports your marketing strategy, strengthens your brand identity, and drives long-term business growth online.

records.name: Steerhaus
records.tagline: The LeetCode for the AI era
records.description: The AI writes the code. You prove you know how to drive it.

records.name: YouTube Chapter Generator
records.tagline: AI chapter detection with visual scene verification
records.description: Unlike tools that only read subtitles, this watches the video. Dual text+visual verification cross-checks topic boundaries against real scene changes for accurate timestamps. Features: upload video/SRT/YouTube link, editable titles, one-click copy to YouTube. Free, offline, zero API. Built with Whisper + CLIP AI.

records.name: YourFinancialModel
records.tagline: Build investor-ready 5-year forecasts in minutes.
records.description: YourFinancialModel.com is built for founders with no finance background and no budget. Free to start, no spreadsheet skills needed — just enter your numbers and get an instant 5-year P&L, profit forecasts, and charts. All formulas built in. Pro tier adds PDF and PowerPoint exports for investor-ready pitch decks. No sign-up friction, no formulas, no MBA required. Already recommended as a startup resource at UK universities.

records.name: familiar
records.tagline: The missing IDE half for your terminal AI-agent workflow
records.description: Working with Claude Code or another terminal AI agent means constant context-switching: you can't easily review its diffs, dig through past sessions, or check git history without leaving for a full IDE. familiar fixes that with full-screen kitty overlays bringing IDE-grade diff review, live session browsing, and git log exploration into your terminal — so you stay in the AI-agent workflow with far less need for a separate IDE. Built for macOS for now, may expand if there's demand.

records.name: Orbetric
records.tagline: Think Beyond Tomorrow
records.description: Orbetric AI is a next-gen SaaS platform operating as an always-on Business Assistant. By blending the strengths of ChatGPT, Nvidia, Grok, DeepSeek, and Gemini into one dashboard, it automatically routes tasks to the best engine behind the scenes. The platform features live web search for fact-checked research, tailored Marketing and Finance workspaces, and built-in image generation. Currently in its Seed stage, Orbetric helps modern enterprises grow smarter and decide faster.

records.name: Animate AI
records.tagline: Turn your story or script into an AI animated short
records.description: Animate AI turns a story idea or script into a finished animated MP4 — no animation team, no editing skills. Generation runs automatically: submit your story, spend credits, and your video lands in your account in minutes, with optional subtitles. Pick 5, 15, or 30 seconds, exported as vertical 9:16 by default (16:9 and 1:1 too), ready for TikTok, Shorts, and Reels. Pay once for credits that never expire — auto-retry is built in, and you're refunded if a generation fails. Starts at $15.

records.name: Future Note
records.tagline: Write to your future self. Seal it. Reply when it returns.
records.description: Future Note is an iOS app for sealed letters to your future self. Write a note, lock it until a date you choose — no peeking, no editing — and when it returns, reply to the version of you who wrote it. Both letters live on a private timeline. Free to start.

records.name: MyStreaky
records.tagline: The Strava for language learners
records.description: Many language learners struggle with motivation, but they also struggle with staying organized and tracking their progress. I built Mystreaky after years of learning languages and having everything scattered across books, apps, notes, videos, and random bookmarks. Mystreaky is a free platform to track your language learning journey, build streaks, organize resources, and keep everything in one place. Think of it as a fitness tracker for language learning.

records.name: HandyTools
records.tagline: 15 free developer tools with a Windows 95 interface
records.description: HandyTools is a collection of 15 free developer and productivity tools — JSON formatter, regex tester, base64 & URL encoders, UUID & password generators, unit & color converters, and more — all wrapped in a nostalgic Windows 95 interface. Everything runs 100% in your browser: no signup, no ads, no tracking, nothing uploaded to a server. Just open a tool and go.

records.name: FairHire
records.tagline: Catch risky job-post language before it becomes a lawsuit
records.description: Paste a job posting. FairHire flags compliance risks, quoting the exact phrase and the requirement it may miss (pay transparency, EEO, age-coded language). Built for solo recruiters, with free anonymous audits and plans from $29/mo vs $14k/yr enterprise tools.

records.name: Wallpaper Slideshow
records.tagline: Refresh your wallpaper automatically your favorite photos.
records.description: Wallpaper Slideshow is a lightweight personalization app that automatically rotates your home and lock screen wallpapers from your favorite albums or folders. Customize slideshow intervals, shuffle images, and enjoy a fresh look every time you unlock your phone—all while keeping setup simple and intuitive. Similar apps in this category let users select folders, customize intervals, shuffle wallpapers, and support both home and lock screens.

records.name: Managers Playbook
records.tagline: An AI chief of staff for people managers, on device
records.description: Managers Playbook runs the operational machine of management so you can focus on your people. Track your team, prep and log 1:1s (GROW), capture SBI/STAR feedback, run a weekly/monthly cadence, and rank work with RICE and Eisenhower - all free. Pro (one-time, no subscription) adds an AI assistant that drafts replies, turns a 1:1 into action items and feedback, and writes status reports - on Apple Intelligence on-device or a small model you download. Nothing leaves your phone unless you choose.

records.name: TellAcross
records.tagline: Talk to anyone in their language — no app to install
records.description: TellAcross is real-time, voice-to-voice translation for live calls. Start a call, share a link — the other person joins from any browser with nothing to install. You each speak your own language and hear the other in theirs, in under a second, in a natural voice. 100+ languages (incl. full Indic), live transcript, and modes for business, medical, legal & education. Free to try.

records.name: Dropling
records.tagline: Learn anything through your lock screen — no app to open
records.description: Dropling turns anything you want to learn into short questions delivered to your lock screen. Answer right on the notification — no unlocking, no app to open. Questions arrive spread across your day. On iPhone and Apple Watch. Free to try.

records.name: Easy Calculator Nex
records.tagline: 90+ free calculators for money, health, work & home
records.description: Easy Calculator Nex is a free collection of 90+ online calculators covering finance, construction, business, work/payroll, health, dates, and math conversions — from loan payments and BMI to concrete estimates and ROI. No signup, no ads blocking results, instant answers. Organized into 7 clear categories so you find the right calculator in seconds instead of digging through generic search results.

records.name: NOTTS Muscle Aches & Pain 24 Caplets
records.tagline: Fast Relief. Real Comfort.
records.description: Struggling with sore, tired, or overworked muscles? Notts® Muscle Aches & Pain Caplets deliver fast, effective relief so you can get back to your day. Formulated to target deep muscle discomfort from workouts, strains, or everyday tension, each caplet is easy to swallow and works quickly to ease pain at the source. Trusted for reliable, long-lasting comfort, this 24-count pack is perfect for keeping on hand at home, work, or on the go.

records.name: HireJack
records.tagline: 130K+ tech jobs, matched to your resume - inside Claude
records.description: HireJack tracks 130,000+ jobs from 366 tech companies daily. Resume Match scores, Company Fit, ATS resume tips, salary benchmarks - plus 31 MCP tools so Claude can run your whole job search. Free to start, 14-day Pro trial included.

records.name: AssignMate
records.tagline: The managed peer-to-peer student freelance network
records.description: Every campus has two kinds of students: some drowning in deadlines, others sitting idle with real skills and free time. AssignMate connects them no more chaotic WhatsApp groups, no more sketchy Instagram agencies. Just a managed, verified network built for both sides.

records.name: SecretScout — API Key & Secret Detector
records.tagline: Catch exposed API keys and secrets while you browse
records.description: SecretScout scans pages you visit for accidentally exposed API keys (OpenAI, AWS, Stripe, GitHub, Google) in DOM, scripts and network responses. 100% local — nothing leaves your browser. Built for developers and security engineers who care about credential hygiene.

records.name: CalTracker
records.tagline: Clean calorie and macro counting app.
records.description: CalTracker makes nutrition tracking effortless. Snap a photo of your meal to log calories and macros in seconds, then track your weight, water intake, steps, and daily progress—all in one clean app. Unlike traditional calorie trackers, CalTracker is designed to be fast, simple, and enjoyable to use, helping you build healthy habits without tedious manual logging or cluttered interfaces.

records.name: Remi
records.tagline: All-in-one voice-first expense tracker.
records.description: Track your spending with your voice. Remi uses AI to instantly categorize expenses and deliver smart spending summaries.

records.name: Huint
records.tagline: Give your AI agents eyes in the real world
records.description: Huint is a production MCP photo-task platform. AI agents create location-based or global Tasks, and iOS Taskers return verified real-world proof.

records.name: slug-generator/
records.tagline: Free Slug Generator to Create SEO-Friendly URL Slugs Online
records.description: Creating clean URLs shouldn't be complicated. Our Free Slug Generator instantly converts titles or text into SEO-friendly URL slugs by removing unnecessary characters, converting text to lowercase, and using hyphens for better readability. ✅ SEO-Friendly URL Slugs ✅ Lowercase Conversion ✅ Remove Special Characters ✅ Hyphen-Separated URLs ✅ Fast Browser-Based Tool ✅ No Signup Required 🔗 https://technofirstonline.com/slug-generator/

records.name: MedVoq.ai
records.tagline: AI that documents every doctor visit
records.description: MedVoq.ai is a multilingual AI medical scribe. It listens to the doctor patient consultation in any language even switching mid-conversation and instantly generates a complete, structured prescription: complaint, medications, history, and follow up The doctor approves it in one tap, and the patient receives it directly Live in a hospital pilot now.

records.name: Branda
records.tagline: Turn any domain into on-brand ads, MIT Open Source
records.description: Branda turns any website URL into scroll-stopping, on-brand ads in seconds. Paste a link and Branda pulls the brand's real logo, colors, and campaign imagery via Context.dev's Brand API, reads the homepage so the copy sounds like the brand, and generates ready-to-ship creatives for LinkedIn and X. No login, no design skills, no assets to upload. Open-source and self-hostable.

records.name: Resto Mart
records.tagline: RestoMart
records.description: Get the best quality convenience items all under one roof in affordable prices at RestoMart. We provide a wide range of items that includes finest quality cooking ingredients, best baking supplies and effective cleaning products all at a press of a button. Head to our website now and avail your desired items at the most affordable prices.

records.name: VibeCheckr
records.tagline: Drop your selfie. Get roasted by AI. Share the chaos 🔥
records.description: Upload your selfie → get a brutal AI personality breakdown, aura score & savage roast. 20+ tools: Duo compatibility, Toxic Ex Scanner, Delulu Check, Situationship Clarifier, Reply Guru & more. Shareable viral result cards built for TikTok & Instagram. Streak system, daily zodiac vibe & token economy included. Free & instant. Web + iOS + Android.

records.name: GpxFile.pro — GPX & FIT File Tools
records.tagline: Plan routes, convert maps, edit, merge, split GPX files
records.description: GpxFile.pro is a free suite of GPX tools for cyclists, hikers, and anyone using a GPS device. Convert Google Maps, Bing Maps, or Apple Maps routes to GPX. Plan a route from scratch by clicking on a map. View, edit, trim, split, merge, and simplify GPX files — all in the browser, no sign-up required.

records.name: BackPage FC
records.tagline: The football stories mainstream media won't tell you
records.description: ⚽ Tired of "reports suggest" and same-day recaps? So were we. BackPage FC digs into football stories mainstream sites skip — transfer sagas that don't fit a headline, players nobody profiles, club history that explains why today's news matters. Every piece sourced, not recycled 🔍 🆕 Just launched: Transfer Records — every PL club's biggest signing AND sale ever, real fees, real dates, real receipts 🧾 No hot takes. No filler. 🔥

records.name: Breva
records.tagline: Turn your Mac trackpad into a gentle breathing guide
records.description: Breva turns your Mac trackpad into a gentle breathing guide. Choose a breathing pattern, set a session length, and follow a soft expanding orb with optional audio and haptic cues. It works locally, needs no account, and helps you take short reset breaks without reaching for your phone.

records.name: TgDraw
records.tagline: Giveaways, polls and quizzes for Telegram
records.description: TgDraw is a convenient tool for running activities in Telegram. It is a multifunctional bot for channel and group admins that helps create giveaways, interactive polls and quizzes through a user-friendly interface. Giveaways include subscription checks, a fair randomizer, custom stickers and one-click participant export. Polls and quizzes support flexible question formats, custom design, contact collection, promo codes or a random draw, and fast result export.

records.name: RoomGrade
records.tagline: Find the red flags in your data room before investors do
records.description: RoomGrade reads your startup's data room like a VC analyst would, surfacing red flags, missing docs, and metric inconsistencies before you send it to investors. Upload your docs, get an investment memo back in about a minute.

records.name: Interview Coach
records.tagline: Opensource AI interview coach with local LLM & voice support
records.description: Practice realistic mock interviews with AI using OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Groq, or local Ollama models. Voice conversations, instant feedback, customizable interview flows, and complete privacy with offline support. Open source and developer-friendly.

records.name: Bremo
records.tagline: Every current Canadian bank bonus in one clean table
records.description: Bremo is a free Canadian personal-finance comparison site. It ranks every current Canadian bank welcome bonus, reviews no-fee chequing accounts, and publishes plain-English guides for Canadians. Every offer is verified against the provider's live terms before publishing and re-verified weekly. Built in Guelph, Ontario. Bonus Index sits at $3,950 across 11 offers as of July 2026.

records.name: RepoFold
records.tagline: Your codebase, explained. Always current.
records.description: RepoFold turns a GitHub repo into a wiki you can trust: every claim cites the exact file and lines, validated against the parsed source. It updates itself on every push, and coding agents can query it over MCP. Free during beta.

records.name: 360now
records.tagline: AI-powered 360° feedback for leaders.
records.description: Most leaders have no idea how their team really experience them. Honest feedback is hard to get and existing 360 tools are clunky, slow and built for enterprise budgets. We were those leaders. So we built 360now. ✓ Anonymous feedback from your team, peers and manager ✓ Personalised report with AI insights and action plan ✓ Simple, transparent pricing - $129 per leader First 50 ProductHunt users free - use code PH50 ✓ Sign up ✓ Add your raters (min. 6) ✓ Complete self assessment.

records.name: Souls Network
records.tagline: Identity-based interpersonal connection platform.
records.description: Interpersonal discovery platform that replaces the conventional visual catalog with an identity-based system. The algorithm optimizes real compatibility by evaluating personality traits and interests, eliminating popularity metrics to ensure equity. Its modular architecture expands the digital experience by integrating a relational learning module, a geolocalized map for real-world encounters, and a conversational companion with persistent identity and memory powered by artificial intelligence.

records.name: Pabo
records.tagline: The delivery app that never delivers
records.description: Browse a fake catalog, spend pretend money, and track a snail who slowly delivers your order. Nothing real ever ships. That is the point. All the joy of ordering, none of the packages.

records.name: AI Product Margin Calculator
records.tagline: Know your AI agent unit economics.
records.description: Free AI margin calculator to analyze unit economics, model costs, and pricing strategies. Identify when seat-based pricing becomes unprofitable due to agent loops.

records.name: Name 100 Women
records.tagline: Name 100 verified real women across all eras & industries
records.description: Play Name 100 Women, a free timed memory challenge. Enter 100 real women with no repeats. The timer starts after your first correct answer. Name 100 Women is a free browser memory challenge. Type 100 unique real women from memory—historical or living, all verified via Wikipedia/Wikidata. No hints, no accounts, real-time name validation, shareable results. Organize your memory by music, science, politics, sports, literature & film to beat the timer.

records.name: Loical
records.tagline: Find local volunteer opportunities, events & organizations
records.description: Loical helps you discover activities, events, organizations, and opportunities happening around you, making it easier to connect with your local community.

records.name: Artist.GenTalks for iOS
records.tagline: Turn Any Idea Into an Original Song & Music Video
records.description: Artist.GenTalks is now on iOS! Create original songs in your own voice, turn photos into singing music videos, sing karaoke, build your artist profile, and discover creators worldwide. Use your original creations across TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms for your content. Free signup and your first song is free. Built for creators, musicians, storytellers, and anyone who loves making music.

records.name: L10n.dev - AI Localization Agent
records.tagline: Stop wasting AI tokens on localization. Use MCP instead
records.description: Connect GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and Windsurf to a professional AI localization engine throw ai-l10n MCP server. Translate i18n files in 165 languages with guaranteed format preservation, AI glossary generation, persistent linguistic instructions, incremental updates, and server-side processing that keeps large localization files out of your agent's context window, reducing token usage while delivering production-ready translations. Also you can automate localization with CLI

records.name: PassportApp
records.tagline: Get the perfect, compliant passport photos in 60 seconds!
records.description: Get your passport photo approved fast, from home! No phot booths, no queues. Take or upload a selfie and download a compliant digital photo in minutes. Stop wasting time at pharmacies or expensive photo booths. Passport-Photo.app instantly crops, removes the background and verifies your photo against strict government compliance rules for any country. Download print-ready or digital-ready files instantly.

records.name: AfterWurk — Employee Bonding, Reimagined
records.tagline: The after-work activities platform for HR teams
records.description: AfterWurk is a private, company-branded platform where employees at companies with 1,000+ employees can discover and join casual after-work activities, frisbee golf, trivia nights, board games, hikes, virtual hangouts. Most culture initiatives fail because they're top-down and forced. AfterWurk flips that, Employees self-organize activities they actually want to do, on their own time, voluntarily.

records.name: thepressjournal
records.tagline: The Press Journal: Real Stories Behind the Headlines
records.description: Go beyond breaking news with deep reporting, real context, and real human stories that uncover the truth behind the headlines shaping our world every single.

records.name: Converly Colors
records.tagline: Free color palette generator — creates design.md for devs
records.description: Converly Colors is a free AI color palette generator that creates design.md files — the standard design token format used by Claude, Cursor and v0. No signup required. Generate 12-step scales, light/dark modes and CSS variables instantly. Built by Converly, an AI automation company from Spain. Perfect for developers and designers building AI-assisted workflows.

records.name: PokeBot
records.tagline: Career readiness layer for hiring
records.description: PokeBot is the career readiness layer for hiring. Unlike tools that only rewrite resumes or run one-off mock interviews, PokeBot connects career planning, role fit, resume feedback, voice mock interviews, skill-gap tracking, readiness badges, and warm-intro opportunities—so candidates can move from “I claim I’m ready” to measurable proof.

records.name: Animos App
records.tagline: Showcase your designs in motion
records.description: Present your work with high-quality motion in under 1 minute. Animos is a browser-based animation tool built for creators. The workflow is simple: pick a template, drop in your assets, tweak, and export. With 30+ templates, 4K resolution, and MP4/WebM support, you can easily generate stunning, web-ready animations for your portfolio.

records.name: MeshTik
records.tagline: Free WireGuard config generator for MikroTik & any device
records.description: MeshTik turns a full WireGuard mesh setup into a 2-minute job. Describe your nodes once — MikroTik routers, laptops, phones — and get ready-to-paste RouterOS v7 commands plus universal wg-quick configs for every other device in the same mesh. All keys are generated locally in your browser with Curve25519, nothing is uploaded, and it works offline. Free, no account. Download configs individually, as a zip, or scan a QR to import into the WireGuard mobile app.

records.name: Unbury
records.tagline: Get your emails seen by the people who signed up
records.description: A done-for-you email marketing service for coaches, consultants, and founders. Strategy, copywriting, deliverability, sending — Unbury runs your list end-to-end so email becomes your most reliable revenue channel.

records.name: Carbon Molecular Sieve
records.tagline: Carbon Molecular Sieve
records.description: SorbiTech Group global Carbon Molecular Sieve manufacturer & supplier. CMS for PSA nitrogen generators: 260L, 350KT, 420KT, 450HP. Request pricing.

records.name: Owl Lattice — Where Thoughts Fly
records.tagline: Windows desktop app for working with multiple AI models
records.description: The Owl Lattice is a multi-AI desktop workspace for Windows. Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini — side by side. Your subscriptions, your data, no api needed.

records.name: alpflo
records.tagline: What Switzerland's public registers say about a parcel
records.description: alpflo turns a Swiss address into a source-verified property brief: building and zoning data, public-law restrictions, and modelled context. Every field links to its official source and shows how certain it is. No valuations, just facts and their provenance. DE / FR / EN.

records.name: RedGifs Bulk Downloader
records.tagline: Save RedGifs MP4 links, metadata, and files
records.description: Download public RedGifs video data from links, IDs, or search. Get direct MP4 links, thumbnails, tags, duration, views, likes, and optional hosted files or ZIP archives for review, archiving, or API workflows.

records.name: Organic Traffic with Expert SEO Services
records.tagline: SEO Services to Grow Your Organic Traffic Faster
records.description: SEO is more than ranking for keywords, it's about attracting the right audience and turning visitors into customers. Our SEO Services help businesses improve online visibility through technical SEO, keyword research, on-page optimization, content strategy, link building, and performance tracking. Every strategy is tailored to your goals, industry, and competition.

records.name: Clipwright
records.tagline: Turning ideas into short slideshow videos with AI
records.description: Clipwright turns one sentence into a narrated, captioned, ready to post video. Scenes illustrated, voiceover recorded, captions timed, music scored, all from a single prompt. Built for creators, parents, and educators.

records.name: CardsRelay
records.tagline: crypto in. cards out
records.description: CardsRelay lets you buy gift cards for thousands of brands and mobile top-ups in almost every country, paid with crypto including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Monero, Zano and Zcash. Codes arrive by email in seconds. No bank, no KYC. One of the few marketplaces that accepts all three major privacy coins directly.

records.name: Agent Keyboard
records.tagline: A prompt bar that lets your app edit itself
records.description: One script tag on your app. Ask for a change — typed, dictated, or photographed — and your own server runs a real Claude Code session that edits your codebase and commits it, right where you're looking. Open source, self-hosted, your keys, MIT.

records.name: NoSignups.Net
records.tagline: No-signups, No installs, Completely open-source
records.description: Click a link, and use a tool. As simple as that! No signups, no installs, no downloads, no tracking, no nothing. Just tools that work made by the passionate open-source community.

records.name: Linkjoy
records.tagline: A link-in-bio tool to unlock your growth
records.description: Linkjoy is a next-gen link-in-bio and link management platform for creators, entrepreneurs, and small businesses.
